provenance: Synthetic numerical fixtures for the separately repaired r12 plant. Some numerical regression inputs are explicitly reused from the inspected r9 fixture configuration, but no historical vehicle mass, inertia, geometry, travel or response is selected. Base geometry is newly expressed in the r12 separated-origin schema with a positive-down bottom pivot. No supplier performance, CAD assembly or hardware calibration is represented.

implementation_contract.note: Fixture providers, runner and checker must import the new package and migrate together. Configuration existence does not establish runnable code.

frame_contract.body: FRD; axes rigidly attached to central structure
frame_contract.mission_scoring_reference: fixed airframe datum O_B0; apply CG offset and offset-rate conversion
frame_contract.quaternion: scalar-first Hamilton q_LB; R_LB maps B into L
frame_contract.euler: named roll, pitch and yaw in radians; Rz(yaw) Ry(pitch) Rx(roll)
frame_contract.gimbal: R_BM=Rx(alpha)Ry(beta); outer body-fixed x, inner carried y
frame_contract.spin_sign_reference: signed rotation about common +z_M, not visual CW/CCW without a viewing direction
frame_contract.units: SI except explicitly named CAD mm and geometric mm^5 inputs

mass_properties.provenance: Explicitly synthetic constant complete-body mass and full inertia, reused solely as regression inputs from the inspected r9 configuration; not selected vehicle data.
limitations: Frozen rigid-body fixture deliberately omits rotor and joint relative momentum and moving-mass effects.
Prescribed actuator motion with frozen mass properties is not complete articulated-vehicle dynamics.
No complete vehicle ledger or hardware mass reconciliation is represented.

geometry.provenance: BOTTOM-PIVOT ANALYTICAL FIXTURE: coincident joint origins explicitly supplied, pivot 0.30 m in positive FRD z from zero fixture CG, and both hubs below the pivot at neutral. These are invented sign-test coordinates, not CAD geometry, selected lever arms, rotor spacing or clearance evidence.

lag_parameters.provenance: Synthetic first-order motor response and cascaded common-progress gimbal filters. Numerical values are regression inputs only, not historical hardware selections or loaded-response calibration.
limitations: Speed-command abstraction, not an ESC PWM, voltage or duty interface.
No demonstrated hardware speed regulation or loaded joint response.
Mechanical torque limits, backlash, friction, compliance, deadband, delay and thermal dynamics are omitted.
Effective gimbal rates may be reduced by the implementation's explicit acceleration-bound construction.

environment.electrical_model: Prescribed constant terminal voltage, SOC, auxiliary demand and temperatures; no battery/thermal evolution.
environment.nonpropulsive_load_model: Base fixture explicitly omits exposed-structure aerodynamics, wake-on-structure, disturbances and contact.
environment.provenance: Prescribed analytical environment, not a verified operating envelope.
limitations: Ambient calm air does not establish negligible wake or rotational aerodynamic loads.
No legacy cylinder aerodynamic model is adopted for the exposed structure.
Fixed SOC and temperatures cannot establish endurance or thermal-duration feasibility.
Actual hub positions must be supplied by the plant at each evaluation, not stored in this configuration.
Auxiliary demand is included once in total shared-bus arithmetic, but complete electrical closure remains absent.

synthetic_paired_map.formula: For rotor i and other rotor j: d_i=1+chi_i*(abs(omega_j)/omega_ref)^2; T_i=kT_i*omega_i^2/d_i; Q_i=kQ_i*omega_i^2/d_i.
synthetic_paired_map.provenance: Invented coupled functions for paired-map and signed-load regression checks. NOT supplier data, measured interference or accepted propulsion capability.
limitations: Spacing, inflow, density and temperature are received but do not affect these synthetic functions.
All physical domain flags remain unresolved in the base fixture.
Current estimates omit acceleration energy, motor voltage/duty closure and battery sag.
Idle-current arithmetic is not an ESC off-state model.
Equal coefficients enable a closed-form numerical trim fixture; equal RPM need not balance a real pair.

solver.note: Numerical settings and output sampling are not PID cadence or physical acceptance tolerances. No controller executes.

rotation_identities.note: Use independent rotation matrices and component Hamilton algebra as oracles. Check q/-q equivalence, multiplication order, transpose direction and preservation of raw stored norm error.

spherical_free_rotation.note: Explicitly set both propulsion coefficients and all additional loads to zero, with zero actuator states/commands. Retain the nonzero initial rigid-body state. Compare ballistic CG translation and constant-body-rate Hamilton exponential orientation; no physical rotor-off electrical assertion follows.

trim.formula: For identical paired coefficients, neutral gimbal, identity attitude and zero rates: omega_trim^2=m*g/(2*kT-m*g*chi/omega_ref^2). Compute from actual configuration and reject a nonpositive denominator or out-of-limit speed.
trim.note: Opposite signs and equal aerodynamic Q balance the synthetic axial couples. This is open-loop analytical trim, not closed-loop hover, endurance or mission acceptance.

bottom_pivot_effectiveness.expected_thrust_moment_formula: [-h*T*sin(alpha)*cos(beta),-h*T*sin(beta),0], with h computed from this coincident-axis base fixture's pivot minus CG
bottom_pivot_effectiveness.expected_neutral_derivatives: dMx/dalpha=-h*T and dMy/dbeta=-h*T, both negative for h>0
bottom_pivot_effectiveness.note: Use the actual adapter and actual artifact inputs. These simplified formulae are restricted to the centred coincident-axis fixture; they are not a vehicle allocator or a universal lever-arm model.

differential_aerodynamic_torque.note: Check each transformed air-on-rotor couple R_BM*[0,0,-sigma_i*Q_i], its sum, and separation from point-force moments. Unequal torque coefficients at equal RPM must not be forced to cancel. No internal motor/servo couple is added.

unlimited_lag.note: Initialize both gimbal filter stages at the specified initial angles. Confirm limiting is inactive before using exponential motor and equal-time-constant cascaded-gimbal analytical solutions.

saturated_command.note: Test commanded limits, actual lag, rate/acceleration bounds, joint/cone domains and explicit endpoint carry-forward through a held-command change. This is actuator response, not PID saturation-recovery acceptance.

momentum_balance.note: Instantaneous algebraic interface fixture only. Check the full angular-momentum residual independently; do not integrate this snapshot as a claimed consistent articulated trajectory.

offset_kinematics.note: Prescribed instantaneous kinematics for hub and fixed-datum conversions. Construct independent local time-varying positions for finite differences; nonzero CG rate must not be attached to FrozenFixtureMass.

separated_origin_geometry.provenance: NONCOINCIDENT-ORIGIN ANALYTICAL FIXTURE: invented three-component joint displacement and offset coaxial thrust line. No hardware or CAD geometry is selected.

external_point_load.provenance: Synthetic nonpropulsive external point load for exactly-once CG-shift and free-couple accounting. Not a calibrated aerodynamic load.

time_argument_and_purity.note: A checker-specific pure provider varies an explicit external force with the supplied time. Repeated identical inputs must reproduce outputs despite out-of-order calls; input states and commands must remain unchanged.

terminal_event.note: Zero-load ballistic CG crossing of a synthetic plane. Compare event time/state with the quadratic solution; requested output times deliberately omit the event endpoint. This is solver-event verification, not a foot-contact or landing model.

CAD_conversion.note: Synthetic points and full tensor for unit/rotation tests, not measurements from CAD artifacts or material selection. Test geometric, kg mm^2 and kg m^2 input paths without duplicate density weighting.

analytical_test_tolerances.status: Proposed numerical regression thresholds, not agreed vehicle acceptance limits

verification_contract.artifact_binding: Retain actual hashes for this configuration, the fixture providers, every tested plant module and editable checker. Include every tested artifact Ref in verify_command inputs.
verification_contract.stdout: Only one VerificationResult JSON object with outcome, explanation and checks. Diagnostic measurements and tracebacks go to stderr.
verification_contract.independence: Compute expectations from actual inputs using independent analytical expressions, residuals or finite differences; do not use the tested function as its own oracle.
verification_contract.outcomes: Retain measured errors, failed checks, unexpected exceptions and inconclusive checks. Never convert process exit zero into physical acceptance.
verification_contract.solver_failure: Test exception/result propagation explicitly. A deliberately injected solver-failure result is a labelled API-contract fixture, not a naturally reproduced numerical failure.
verification_contract.negative_cases: Check invalid schema/shape/nonfinite inputs, zero quaternion, nonphysical inertia, inconsistent rotor signs, old geometry keywords, invalid actuator states, mismatched conditions and false/unresolved domain policies.
verification_contract.scope: Analytical and software-interface verification only; no PID tuning, vehicle closed-loop mission or hardware acceptance.

unperformed_vehicle_work: Chief-selected complete installed mass, articulated CG/full inertia and moving-group ownership.
Actual joint origins, hub/foot coordinates, alignment and physical rotor spin assignments.
Calibrated coupled thrust/torque/current maps and electrical/thermal operating domains.
Loaded motor/ESC/servo response, travel, rate, acceleration and mechanical torque limits.
Rotor/joint relative momentum, gyroscopic effects and reduced-model error assessment.
Exposed-structure aerodynamics, rotor-wake loading and coupled ground contact.
PID implementation/tuning, attitude recovery, tracking, disturbances and saturation-recovery acceptance.
Takeoff, uninterrupted 300-second hover, landing, touchdown and mission-energy acceptance.
PDR/CDR acceptance, structural qualification and hardware/flight validation.
